tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdzas srung gi gdams pa bzhugs so//

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gal po che yi man ngag la// padma rgyal pos phyi rabs don// mna' dang phru slog gtad khram dang*// klu gnyan sa bdag bsrung ba'i phyir// rdzas kyi sbyor thabs gsungs pa rnams// bu la phan phyir bsdeb kyis gson// rta nag mi nag khyi nag dang*// spyang ki stag dang dom la sogs/ khyi rgod pad mtshal gtsang ma dang*// yugs khrag bya yi khrag rnams dang*/ khrag sna thams cad gtang bar bshad// spyang dug dang ni ra dug pa// bang nga nag po bong dug pa// mdor na dug sna thams cad gtang*// 'on kyang khyad par dbye ba ni// bse dri dom khrag lug gi khrag /dme khrag phyi ba phug ron khrag /mdzo dri'u sngags pa'i khrag rnams dang*// btsun pa bon po bya rgod khrag /'di rnams ma gtogs kun la gsag /gzhan yang dug gi khyad par ni// spyang dug g.ya' dug big pan mtshur// mu zi nag po la sogs spang*// de ma gtogs pa'i dug kun gsag /thod pa so sor dug rnams blug /stegs bu'i steng du bzhugs bya ste// rang nyid yi dam gang rung bsgom// sgom bzlas byas pa'i rjes thob tu// bsang sbyang byas te stong pa las// rdzas rnams thams cad khro bo ni// rang gi lha dang mtshungs par bsgom// snying rje'i sngags las 'od 'phros pas// kun kyang me ru bsgom bya ste// me ni sbud pas bus pa bzhin// sngags bzlas tshe na me rnams kun// rab tu 'bar bas dgra bgegs ni// thams cad sreg pa nyid du bsgom// oṃ na mo buddha ya/ badzra kī li kī la ya/ nā ga du tsandhe tsandhe/ mi li mi li/ bhandha bhandha/ nā ga ni swā hā/ sngags 'di 'bum du bzla bar bya// rtags ni me 'od 'bar ba 'am// thod pa 'phar ba la sogs kyang*// rmi lam dngos su 'byung bar bshad// de yi rjes su dug khrag rnams// drag las byed na rgod ru g.yas// g.yas g.yon rgur ba man ngag go

/gzhi gcig gnas na oṃ bhir bya// kun la spra rtsi sgo ngas byug /de nang dug khrag kun blugs te/ khrag rlon dag gis sbyar byas nas/ kha bcad gzungs thag btags nas ni// sngar ltar sgom bzlas 'bum du byas// rtags ni drod brtan dgun mi 'khyag /de sogs dngos su 'byung ba yin/ ༈ /med thabs med pa'i rdzas bshad kyis/ khra dang gri khrag padma'i khrag /khrag sna 'di rnams med mi rung*// bong nga sha chen 'bri tshil ma// dug sna 'di rnams med mi rung*/ ༈ /dug khrag sbyor lugs bstan pa ni// rang gi lha srung dgyes bya'i phyir// bzang drug thum po btags par bya// drag las chu mig gnyan du 'bo// phru slog la sogs mna' byed na// gnas gsum dug khrag thig le bya// rims dang 'go bag la sogs la// bu ga dgu por thig le bya// ser srung la sogs phran tshegs la// rang rang gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub// 'di yi phan yon dpag tu med// klu dang sa bdag gtad khram ldog /mdze 'phro gcod cing mna' yang ldog /rims dang gag lhog gzer rnams thub// mdor na kun thub rgyal po yin// 'di la dam tshig rnam gnyis te// bud med rnams kyis mthong mi rung*// lag pas reg pa smros ci dgos// dam med dgra la bstan mi bya// gnam lcags ser ba 'bab gyur na// tho cos sa la brdab mi bya// 'di la dgos pa rnam gnyis yod// nyin rer lcags mkhar 'od kyi sngags/ kha gso'i phyir du gdab par bya// rlan dang ma bral chang gtsang blug /'di ni man ngag gdams pa yin// 'di la 'khor lo gsum yod de// pho 'khor mo 'khor spyi 'khor gsum// lus la btags pas kun thub yin/ khyad par klu dang sa bdag thub// gzhan gyi mnan gtad byad rnams thub// 'khor lo yig chung zur na gsal/ ༈ /sngags rnams sham bu bstan pa ni// lcags 'khor 'od sngags sham bu ni// rā dza mā ra ya ni rbad/ rā tsa siddhi mā ra ya gtub/ rā dza siddhi mā ra ya dzaḥ

pho gdon gnod na gdags par bya// ma ma zhung tri dza mā ra ya dza/ ma nu tri mā ra ya rbad// mo gdon gnod na gdags par bya// tri'u mā ra ya dza/ tri shi mā ra ya/ tri'u mā ra ya rbad/ 'gong po gnod na gdags par bya/ oṃ sa ra sa ra bi ya ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ zho chang bsrung na gdags par bya// hūm̐ bha ta ya/ bha ta ya/ lo ka bha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa zlog /rbod gtong zlog na gdags par bya/ oṃ tadya thā/ tig gi tig gu li u li sha shu gi gu la ti bhi ri hu ya hu ya/ hi ri hi ri swā hā/ ser ba srung na gdags par bya/ oṃ ka sha ka sha ka pra tshal shag nad kyi snying mgo dkar po chod swā hā/ lha srin sde brgyad sa bdag klu gnyan dang*// sde brgyad kun la rgyun du bzlas pas chog /de rnams sngags kyi ngar gso bstan pa'o/ ༈ /las mtha' so sor bstan pa ni// srung ba byed na gzhung bzhin bya// pho gdon gnod na khyi dkar thod ling gzhug /nyungs dkar nyungs nag gu gul dris// thun gyis brabs la rgya gram mnan// mo gdon khyi mo nag mo yi// thod par liṅga kun bcug la// nyungs dkar nyungs nag mu nag dang*// zi ra nag po'i thun gyis brab// ma them 'og tu mnan pa bya// 'gong pos gnod par ri bong gi /thod pa'i nang du ling ga btsud// nyungs dkar nyungs nag ke tshe dang*// thun gyis legs par de la brab// tha ma mal gyi 'og tu mnan// gang la byed kyang zhag gsum gzir// zho chang rde'u dkar nag sngags// snod kyi phyi nang dug khrag byug /rbod gtong zlog na dmar gtor la// sngags te zor du 'phangs pas zlog /ser srung phur pa bcu la sngags// phyogs mtshams dbus su 'dzug par byed// ke tshe thal chen nyungs dkar nag /sngags bzlas byung tshe gdong du brdeg /phur pa gsor zhing sdigs par bya// 'khor lo bstan zhing zhag bdun bsgyur// des ni lo tog thub nges so// nad rims bsrung bar 'dod pa na// tshon skud lnga la srung sngags bzlas// dug khrag thum po lus la btags// nad dang rims kyis tshugs mi 'gyur// las kyi mtha' bsgyur bstan pa'o// sri'u gso bar 'dod pa na// skar ma rgyal gyi nam phyed la// ma la srung btags dbang bskur bya// skyes nas bu la chags med bskur// gal te smyo 'bog 'dul ba na// dug khrag ril bu khog tu btang*// rang gi gdong dang lus la byug

/drag sngags bzlas shing spyi brdeg bya// sho mur khyi nag thod pa ru// dug khrag thal chen nyungs dkar nag /blugs la yugs sa'i dor rtas dril// tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram dkris// rang la sbas pas nges par thub// 'di ltar padma 'byung gnas kyis// mnga' bdag rje la gdams pa yin// man ngag rin chen gser 'dra 'di// chos dpal bzang po zhes bya yis// kun la phan phyir yi ger bris// dge zhing bkra shis maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ bla ma la na mo/ 'dir thun gyi zin bris la/ snod gsum la rwa gnyis oṃ bhi dang gsum/ rdzas ni khrag sna tshogs tshad la/ yugs sa/ mdze can/ sngags pa/ lug /btsun pa/ bse dri can/ mdzo dang dre'u dme can gyi khrag spang*/ med du mi rung ba la skyes dar ma grir shi ba'i khrag /bra dkar/ nya dkar/ ag tse/ spyang ki /rta g.yag /khyi nag /gtsod/ gcan gzan/ dri can ma yin pa'i khrag /padma sad kyis ma khyer ba'i khrag /spyang dug dbyig dug ma yin pa'i dug sna tshogs tshad la mtshur big pan/ mu zi dman gyi rigs mi nyan/ med du mi rung ba la btsan dug shang lang nag po/ ra dug nag po/ 'bri tshil/ thar nu/ dur byid/ thang phrom pa/ bong nga nag po/ ༈ sgrub pa la skam sgrub dang rlon sgrub gnyis las/ thod pa'i nang du khrag rnams nyi ma la bskams pa chab hrol pos thod pa ci khengs par bkang*/ lha gang yin bdag bskyed rdzogs rjes/ mdun bskyed 'od zer spro bsdu/ khro chung me ris dgra bgegs log 'dren sa bdag klu gnyan bsregs bcom par bsam la/ rtags nam byung bzla/ thun mtshams ma da na nyung ba gcig la mchil ma btab/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rdzas dang ro gcig tu gyur pas rdzas nus ldan du gyur par bsam/ de dag gtun du phye mar brdungs nas/ snod gsum gang rung nang du/ su rā dang*/ sngags kyi su rā rnying pas bska sla zho tsam du byas la/ bdag mdun dmigs pa sngar dang mthun/ lha sngags sham du/ buddha ya yi sham bu btags la/

rtags ma byung bar du phus btab cing bzla/ 'dir ye shes pa yang yang thim pa'i rdzas nus ldan du bsam/ rtags kho las me 'bar/ rlangs pa 'byung*/ drod skyes 'byung*/ dam tshig bud med kyis mthong mi rung zhing*/ reg pa yang mtshungs/ phan yon tshad pas shes so// rwa dong gi snyan brgyud rwa ban chos dpal bzang pos bdag bya bral nam mkha' dge la gnang ba'o// de nas rim brgyud rin chen bkra bzang bas bdag sgrol ma pa chos rgyal la'o/// /
